item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q015_artifact_tag_not_homology","answer":"d1a14h2 is the eight-residue N-terminal segment (residues 1–8; sequence QVQLQQSG). SCOPe 2.08 classifies it as l.1.1.1: Artifacts class, Tags fold, Tags superfamily, Tags family, specifically an N-terminal tag of synthetic origin. It is therefore an engineered/artifact segment, not a separate natural protein domain and not part of the b.1.1.1 immunoglobulin domain d1a14h1. Similarity to this very short segment must not be treated as evidence of protein homology—even a match within this artifact family does not imply shared natural ancestry—and it is unsafe for function transfer, evolutionary inference, or selecting a structural template for the biological protein.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1a14","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1a14/chains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1a14/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1a14h2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/343393","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/311501","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310894","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310682","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310607","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310606","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310573","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/310555","/api/v1/sequences/pdb/1a14/chains/H?release=2.08"]}]}
